testControllerSnapshotFiltersNonControll.desc: Checks that the snapshot only keeps wheel, joystick, gamepad and xinput (4 entries out of 8 devices).

testConnectionChangesContainAddedAndRemo.desc: Checks that an added device and a removed one give two events, connection first.

testReplacedDeviceSlotReportsBothTransit.desc: Checks that a wheel replaced in the same slot reports the connection of the new one and the disconnection of the old one.

testOnlyDirectWindowFullscreenTransition.desc: Checks that only direct Window/Fullscreen transitions are tracked.
